name: Home Cleaning
tagline: Reliable upkeep for a home that always feels fresh.
shortDescription: Regular cleaning for kitchens, bathrooms, bedrooms, and living areas so your home stays fresh week after week.
description: Our home cleaning service keeps the spaces you live in every day clean, tidy, and comfortable. It is designed for recurring visits — weekly, every two weeks, or monthly — so your home never has the chance to fall behind.
Tell us about your priorities and any rooms that need extra attention, and our team will follow a consistent checklist on every visit.

benefits.title: Consistent results
benefits.description: A clear, repeatable checklist so you know what to expect every visit.

benefits.title: More free time
benefits.description: Hand over routine chores and spend your time on what matters to you.

benefits.title: Flexible frequency
benefits.description: Choose a schedule that suits your household and adjust it as needed.

included: Dusting of reachable surfaces, shelves, and décor
Vacuuming and mopping of all floors
Kitchen counters, sink, stovetop, and appliance exteriors
Bathroom sinks, toilets, showers, tubs, and mirrors
Making beds and tidying living areas
Emptying bins and replacing liners

pricing.note: Flat rate per booking. Includes everything listed under “What’s included”.

faqs.question: Do I need to provide cleaning supplies?
faqs.answer: Supply arrangements will be confirmed during booking. If you have preferred products, you can note them in your booking details.

faqs.question: Can I choose which rooms are cleaned?
faqs.answer: Yes. Use the booking notes to highlight priority rooms or areas you would like the team to skip.

name: Deep Cleaning
tagline: A top-to-bottom reset for every corner of your home.
shortDescription: A thorough, detailed clean that reaches the build-up regular cleaning misses — ideal for seasonal resets.
description: Deep cleaning goes beyond routine upkeep. Our team works through the details — baseboards, grout, behind appliances, and inside fixtures — to restore a genuinely fresh feeling to your home.
It is a great choice before or after a special occasion, at the change of seasons, or as a first visit before starting a regular cleaning plan.

benefits.title: Detail-focused
benefits.description: Attention to the areas that are often overlooked during everyday cleaning.

benefits.title: Healthier spaces
benefits.description: Reduce dust and grime build-up in high-touch and hard-to-reach places.

benefits.title: A fresh starting point
benefits.description: Sets a clean baseline that makes regular upkeep easier.

included: Everything in Home Cleaning
Baseboards, door frames, and light switches
Detailed scrubbing of tiles and grout
Inside microwave and exterior of cabinets
Behind and under movable furniture and appliances
Window sills, tracks, and interior glass

pricing.note: Flat rate per booking. Includes everything listed under “What’s included”.

faqs.question: How long does a deep clean take?
faqs.answer: Timing depends on the size and condition of your home. An estimate will be shared when your booking is reviewed.

faqs.question: Can I add the inside of the oven or fridge?
faqs.answer: Add-ons like interior oven or fridge cleaning can be requested in your booking notes.

name: Office Cleaning
tagline: A clean, professional workspace your team will appreciate.
shortDescription: Dependable cleaning for offices and workspaces, scheduled around your business hours.
description: A clean workplace supports productivity and makes a strong impression on clients and visitors. Our office cleaning service covers workstations, shared areas, kitchens, and restrooms.
Visits can be scheduled before or after business hours to minimise disruption, with a scope tailored to the size and needs of your workspace.

benefits.title: Minimal disruption
benefits.description: Scheduling built around your working hours.

benefits.title: Tailored scope
benefits.description: A cleaning plan that reflects how your space is actually used.

benefits.title: Professional impression
benefits.description: A tidy, welcoming environment for staff and visitors.

included: Desks, workstations, and high-touch surfaces
Meeting rooms and reception areas
Kitchen and break-room cleaning
Restroom cleaning and restocking checks
Vacuuming and mopping of floors
Emptying bins and recycling

pricing.note: Flat rate per booking. Includes everything listed under “What’s included”.

faqs.question: Can you clean outside of business hours?
faqs.answer: Yes. Select your preferred time window when booking and add any access instructions in the notes.

faqs.question: Do you offer recurring office contracts?
faqs.answer: Recurring schedules can be discussed once your initial booking request is reviewed.

name: Move-In & Move-Out Cleaning
tagline: Start fresh in your new place — or leave the old one spotless.
shortDescription: A complete clean of empty properties before you move in or after you move out.
description: Moving is demanding enough. Our move-in and move-out cleaning prepares an empty property so it is ready for its next chapter — whether you are settling in or handing over the keys.
Because the space is empty, our team can reach every surface, cupboard, and corner for a truly complete clean.

benefits.title: Ready to live in
benefits.description: Move into a home that feels clean and welcoming from day one.

benefits.title: Smoother handovers
benefits.description: Leave a property in clean condition for the next occupant.

benefits.title: Less moving stress
benefits.description: One less task on your moving checklist.

included: Inside all cabinets, drawers, and closets
Kitchen appliances inside and out (when empty)
Full bathroom cleaning and descaling
Walls spot-cleaned, switches, and doors wiped
Floors vacuumed and mopped throughout
Windows, sills, and tracks

pricing.note: Flat rate per booking. Includes everything listed under “What’s included”.

faqs.question: Does the property need to be empty?
faqs.answer: For the most thorough result, yes. Let us know in your booking notes if any furniture will remain.

faqs.question: Can you work with my moving date?
faqs.answer: Choose your preferred date when booking. We recommend booking as early as possible around busy moving periods.

name: Sofa & Upholstery Cleaning
tagline: Refresh the fabrics you relax on every day.
shortDescription: Careful cleaning for sofas, armchairs, cushions, and upholstered furniture.
description: Upholstered furniture collects dust, spills, and everyday wear. Our upholstery cleaning service refreshes sofas, chairs, and cushions using methods suited to each fabric type.
Let us know about the materials and any specific marks when you book so our team can prepare the right approach.

benefits.title: Fabric-appropriate care
benefits.description: Methods chosen to suit the material being cleaned.

benefits.title: Revived appearance
benefits.description: Help restore the look and feel of well-used furniture.

benefits.title: Fresher living spaces
benefits.description: Reduce dust and odours trapped in soft furnishings.

included: Fabric inspection before cleaning
Vacuuming of seats, crevices, and cushions
Treatment of visible marks where suitable
Cleaning method matched to fabric care codes
Guidance on drying time and aftercare

pricing.note: Flat rate per booking. Includes everything listed under “What’s included”.

faqs.question: Can every stain be removed?
faqs.answer: Results depend on the fabric and the type and age of the stain. Our team will set expectations before starting.

faqs.question: How long until I can use my sofa again?
faqs.answer: Drying time varies by method and fabric. Aftercare guidance will be provided on the day.

name: Post-Construction Cleaning
tagline: From building site to move-in ready.
shortDescription: Removal of dust, debris, and residue after renovations or new builds.
description: Renovation and construction projects leave behind fine dust, residue, and debris that ordinary cleaning cannot handle. Our post-construction service prepares newly built or renovated spaces for use.
Share details about the project and its stage of completion so the right team and equipment can be planned for your space.

benefits.title: Dust-focused process
benefits.description: Systematic removal of fine construction dust from surfaces and fixtures.

benefits.title: Ready for handover
benefits.description: Prepare spaces for occupants, clients, or final inspections.

benefits.title: Safe, careful work
benefits.description: Attention to new finishes, fixtures, and fittings.

included: Removal of light debris and packaging
Dusting of walls, ceilings, vents, and fixtures
Cleaning of windows, frames, and glass
Removal of paint splatter and residue where suitable
Detailed floor cleaning for all surface types
Final wipe-down of kitchens and bathrooms

pricing.note: Flat rate per booking. Includes everything listed under “What’s included”.

faqs.question: When should I book a post-construction clean?
faqs.answer: Book once major works are complete and trades have finished on site, so the space stays clean afterwards.

faqs.question: Do you remove heavy construction waste?
faqs.answer: The service focuses on cleaning. Removal of heavy or bulk waste should be arranged with your contractor.
